title: I'm Tired of Being on the Network
summary: A personal essay expressing frustration with modern software development's heavy reliance on network connectivity, discussing the challenges and trade-offs of building systems that depend on external services, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
problem_solved: Addresses the mental fatigue and technical challenges developers face when working with distributed, network-dependent systems that introduce complexity, latency, and reliability concerns.
why_valuable: Offers a candid perspective on the hidden costs of network dependency in software development, helping developers and architects reflect on their architectural decisions and consider simpler, more resilient alternatives.
